Group 2 Mapping from https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/document-core/StructureDefinition/FRLMAllergyIntolerance to AllergyIntolerance - FR Allergy and intolerance Documentversion: 0.1.0)

Source CodeRelationshipTarget CodeComment
FRLMAllergyIntoleranceis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance (FRAllergyIntoleranceDocument)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.header.identifieris equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.identifier (Identifiant)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.noteis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.note (Additional text not captured in other fields)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.typeis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.type (allergy | intolerance - Underlying mechanism (if known))
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.header.statusis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.clinicalStatus (Statut clinique)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.agentOrAllergenis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.code (agent allergique)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.categoryis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.category (food | medication | environment | biologic)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.periodis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.onset[x] (Date d'identification d'allergie ou d'intolérance)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.period.onsetDateis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.onset[x]:onsetPeriod.start (Starting time with inclusive boundary)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.period.endDateis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.onset[x]:onsetPeriod.end (End time with inclusive boundary, if not ongoing)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.reactionis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.reaction (Réaction observée)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.reaction.agentOrAllergenis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.reaction.substance (Substance responsable de la réaction)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestationis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestation (Symptômes/signes cliniques associés à l’événement)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.certaintyis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus (Certitude)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.criticalityis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.criticality (Criticité)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.reaction.severityis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.reaction.severity (Sévérité)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.reaction.periodnarrowerAllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset (Dates de début et de fin du problème)Le modèle métier porte une période (début/fin), alors que FHIR reaction.onset est un seul instant dateTime.
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.reaction.period.onsetDateis equivalent toAllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset (Dates de début et de fin du problème)
FRLMAllergyIntolerance.reaction.period.endDate(not mapped)Le sous-élément reaction.period.endDate n'est pas mappé explicitement dans le profil FHIR cible. FHIR reaction.onset ne permet pas de représenter explicitement une date de fin.
